correctness.rationale: Dirichlet Green-function equals effective resistance from a follower to the shorted leaders on a tree. Six branch-permutation orbits give exhaustive explicit rational trace formulas. Their differences factor into nonnegative-slope and strictly positive base terms for k>=4; k=3 factors as (t-1)(2t+1)/(2(t+1)) against the only rival, all other types staying strictly above. Exact grounded Laplacian inversion for 950 cases and symbolic identity checks corroborate without substituting for the universal proof.

originality.rationale: Compared the exact graph/objective/continuously weighted optimization against accessible mathematical-record claims and primary material. The fully inspected Fitch–Leonard 2014 treatment solves paths/cycles and motivates joint centrality but does not state this complete spider regime change. Earlier general and one-dimensional works do not directly imply it. An abstract-only 2021 tree paper remains a serious unresolved specialized overlap risk, and novelty is not certified by search failure.

value.rationale: A complete two-leader optimization of an infinite canonical branched-tree family over a continuous physical conductance ratio is a meaningful network-control classification. A unique three-branch switch at t=1 and k>=4 parameter-independent center–leaf regime are structural outcomes, including counts of every optimizer; these are not consequences of simple normalization or renaming.
